verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that LiveKit Agents is open source, pip-installable, and self-hostable, with a keyless OSS server verified hands-on. Those facts reduce lock-in, but they are adjacent to this story. Nothing in the pack documents exporting user data (transcripts, recordings, logs, agent configs or Cloud deployment data) in open formats, or a migration path off LiveKit Cloud.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
